sentences.text: ?Court No. - 74
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12372 of 2023

Applicant :- Irshad
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashvanee Kumar Srivastav,Vishal Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Vishal Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Amit Kumar Shukla, learned
counsel Brief Holder, for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.271 of 2022, under Sections 376 IPC, Police Station Fatehpur Sikari,
District Agra during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 11.9.2022 under Section 376 IPC against the applicant and according to the FIR, on 30.8.2022 applicant committed rape with the informant, who is married lady, in the room of a Hotel.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation against the applicant is totally false and baseless and applicant never committed rape with the informant and the informant is a fully grown up married woman and, therefore, it is not possible to the applicant to commit rape with her.

He further submits that from the perusal of Annexure-5 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application it appears that applicant and informant stayed in the night of 30.8.2022 at Tiwari Guest House, Fatehpur Sikari, Agra and when the statement of owner of the Guest House was Irshad vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174868891/
1 recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. then he also stated that applicant and informant stayed in the night of 30.8.2022 and they checked out his Guest House on 31.8.2022 at about 6.10 AM and this fact clearly suggests that applicant has falsely been implicated by the informant in the present matter.
5. He next submits that the alleged incident of rape is said to have been occurred on 30.8.2022 but FIR of the present case was lodged on 11.9.2022, i.e, after about 12 days and no explanation in this regard has been given by the informant/victim.
6.
He next submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 2.1.2023.

7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayerfor bail and submits that there is specific allegation of rape against the applicant in the FIR as well as in both the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and although from the statement of the owner of the Guest House and from the entry of the register of the Guest House it appears that victim and applicant stayed in the Guest House in the night of 30.8.2022 and informant appears to be the consenting party but this fact has not been admitted by applicant and he denied the allegation of rape and relationship with informant, therefore, no benefit can be extended to the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. Although applicant in paragraph-16 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application has taken defence that husband of the victim/informant has taken loan of Rs. 50,000/- from him and when he demanded his money then he was implicated in the present matter but from the perusal of the record, it appears that applicant and victim/informant stayed in the Hotel for a night and from the perusal of the entry of register of the Hotel and from the statement of the owner of the Guest House (Hotel) it appears that victim/informant herself accompanied the applicant and from the record it could not be reflected that there was either any allegation of forceful stay of the victim/informant or by playing fraud, she had to stay in a Hotel along with applicant over night.
10.
Informant is the married lady about 25 years of age and the story narrated by her prima facie appears to be doubtful.
11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant-Irshad be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
Irshad vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174868891/
2
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 SKM  Irshad vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174868891/
